title: Turas, 17 Grosvenor Road, Rathmines, Dublin 6, D06V002
seoTitle: Turas, 17 Grosvenor Road, Rathmines, Dublin 6, D06V002
description:
Smith & Butler Estates are delighted to present this elegant two-storey-over-basement Georgian period residence to the Dublin 6 property market.

This rare property, situated on one of Dublin’s most desirable residential roads, offers exceptional potential for refurbishment, extension or future development, subject to the necessary planning permission. Occupying a substantial 0.70-acre site, the property presents an exciting opportunity for a discerning purchaser seeking a prestigious family home, investment or development opportunity.

Retaining many of its original period features, the residence benefits from extensive private off-street parking to the front, with vehicular access to the side leading through to the large rear garden. The handsome façade features intricate brick detailing, original-style windows and an attractive decorative gable with ornamental detailing, creating a striking and distinctive presence.

Internally, the generous accommodation extends to approximately 659 sq. m., with well-proportioned reception rooms, high ceilings, original staircases and large windows allowing excellent natural light throughout. The substantial site also offers considerable scope for extension and redevelopment, subject to planning, while the broad front driveway provides exceptional parking provision for a Dublin 6 property.

The mature gardens and surrounding greenery provide a wonderful sense of privacy and tranquillity, despite the property’s convenient position within one of Dublin’s most established and sought-after residential districts. The location offers easy access to a superb selection of amenities, highly regarded schools, public transport links, cafés, restaurants and some of the city’s finest parks.

This is a truly rare opportunity to acquire a substantial Georgian residence combining period character, an exceptional site and significant future potential, in one of Dublin 6’s most prestigious locations.
